g.text: GLP-1 promotional payments per Part D enrollee with diabetes ranged from $0.41 to $4.25 across states

text.style: font-size: 9.69px; font-family: 'Arial', 'Helvetica Neue', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #c3c2b7

g.text: Promotional dollars to prescribers in each state, 2024, per Medicare Part D enrollee with diabetes (US $2.59)

text.style: font-size: 7.41px; font-family: 'Arial', 'Helvetica Neue', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; fill: #898781

g.text: Grey (ID, ME, OR, VT): withheld to protect privacy (too few recipients, or dollars too concentrated). State values largely reflect where a small number of speakers practise: the top 1%

text.style: font-size: 7.41px; font-family: 'Arial', 'Helvetica Neue', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; fill: #898781

g.text: of paid prescribers received most of the dollars. Payments by the recipient's Open Payments state. Denominator: Part D enrollees × BRFSS diabetes prevalence, adults 65+, pooled 3 years.

text.style: font-size: 7.41px; font-family: 'Arial', 'Helvetica Neue', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; fill: #898781

g.text: Source: CMS Open Payments (general payments, promotional natures); CMS Medicare Enrollment; CDC BRFSS.
